description: This is an HTML source file that contains the structure and styling for a web-based database visualizer UI, including embedded JavaScript for dynamic data loading and user interaction.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the server and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resetting current selections and updating the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles display of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables of the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual table cell content, handling different data types and long content.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content when clicked, offering full view for long or object data.
